title: conv2d through im2col
brief: Implement a 2-D convolution's forward and backward pass as a single matrix multiply, plus the output-size and receptive-field formulas that go with it.
hints: im2col only needs to loop over the k*k kernel offsets, not over output positions: for each offset (dh, dw), a single strided slice of the padded input gives every output position's value at that offset at once.
conv2d_forward is w.reshape(C_out, -1) @ col for each item in the batch, plus the bias broadcast over the spatial axis, then a reshape back to (N, C_out, H_out, W_out).

conv2d_backward needs three chain-rule products: dW_mat = dY_mat @ col^T (summed over the batch), db = dY summed over batch and space, and dcol = W_mat^T @ dY_mat, which you then fold back into image shape with the inverse of the im2col gather (col2im): scatter-add each column back into the padded positions it came from, undo the padding, and you have dx.
receptive_field is the recursion r_l = r_{l-1} + (k_l - 1) * jump, where jump is the product of every earlier layer's stride; update jump *= stride_l after using it, not before.
